description: $0.09 via x402: who owns an NFT right now and where its metadata lives — ownerOf, tokenURI, collection name and symbol in one call, with the tokenURI classified as ipfs / on-chain data URI / http so you know how to fetch it. Read from the contract, so it is correct for tokens minted seconds ago and collections no marketplace has indexed. Base, Ethereum, Optimism, Arbitrum, Polygon, Gnosis.
name: chain_nft_owner
